input.short_description: Create, list, and manage pipelines via the v3 REST API with improved error handling and pagination.
input.body:
Pipelines endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=success}}

Create and manage pipelines programmatically. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Current version|body_html=

v3 is the current stable release. Looking for v2? It remains supported but no longer receives new features.

}}

Create a pipeline

POST /v3/pipelines

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=namestringYesHuman-readable pipeline name, unique per workspace.source_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are read from.destination_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are written to.transformsarrayNoOrdered list of transform step definitions. Omit for a pass-through copy.schedulestringNoCron expression. Omit for event-triggered (streaming) pipelines.timeout_secondsintegerNoMaximum execution time per run. Defaults to 3600 seconds (1 hour). New in v3.max_retriesintegerNoMaximum number of retry attempts on transient failures. Defaults to 3. New in v3.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "ingest-orders", "source_connector_id": "conn_pg_orders", "destination_connector_id": "conn_snowflake_dw", "timeout_seconds": 1800, "max_retries": 5 }'}}

List pipelines

GET /v3/pipelines — cursor-paginated, see Rate limits & errors for the pagination envelope.

Pipeline states

Returned pipelines include a state field of draft, active, or paused — see Pipelines for what each means.

What's new in v3

  • Execution timeouts: Specify per-run timeout with the timeout_seconds parameter. Runs exceeding the limit are automatically terminated and retried.
  • Improved retries: The max_retries parameter gives you fine-grained control over retry behavior for transient failures.
  • Enhanced error responses: Error objects now include a retry_after field indicating how long to wait before retrying rate-limited requests.
  • Better pagination: Cursor pagination now includes a has_more boolean for easier client-side logic.
{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Deleting a pipeline|body_html=

Deleting a pipeline does not delete its source or destination connectors, and does not delete events already written to the destination. In-flight runs are allowed to finish before deletion completes.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a pipeline
  • List pipelines
  • Pipeline states
  • What's new in v3
